item.description: The first lunar eclipse of 2026 is scheduled to occur on March 3, 2026. It will be a total lunar eclipse, visible from many parts of the world, including India. Notably, this eclipse is occurring during the week of Holi, which is considered a rare occurrence. During this time, the moon will appear red, hence the name Blood Moon.
